steps.q: Does it make a great product or service?

views.text: In July 2024, Equity Mates outlined Zip’s four key products: Zip Pay, Zip Money with credit lines up to $30,000, Zip Plus charging 12.95% interest on month-end balances over $1,500, and Business Capital, noting it remained a payments player at its core.

episode.title: Zip: Is it back? | Company Deep Dive

views.text: In August 2021, a guest on Equity Mates reported Q4 FY21 revenue of $130 million, $1.8 billion in transaction volume and transactions up well over 200% year on year, pointing to strong customer engagement with the product.

episode.title: CEO Series: Larry Diamond - Retail Investor Earnings Call (first ever!) | Zip Co (ASX: Z1P)

steps.q: Will it keep earning above market profits?

views.text: In October 2026, a guest on Equity Mates argued Zip had become more profitable, was still growing over 30% in the US, had much funding locked in there limiting rate impacts, and was taking share from incumbents.

episode.title: 3 of Australia’s most shorted stocks (and 2 BIG buys)

views.text: In November 2024, Equity Mates noted Q1 results showed global transactions up 23%, US transactions up 43% and profit globally up more than 200%, indicating improving economics in the period.

episode.title: How to analyse any stock in 30 seconds, Bitcoin nears record highs & Pimp my Portfolio with Charlie Viola

views.text: In July 2024, Equity Mates said Zip had never been profitable, citing a $377 million loss in the last year after larger losses of $1.1 billion and $678 million in prior years, and framed profitability as the key question.

episode.title: Zip: Is it back? | Company Deep Dive

steps.q: Can it reinvest its profits productively?

views.text: In August 2021, a guest on Equity Mates described raising $400 million via unsecured convertible notes to fund global growth, adding Australia was cash flow break-even and the balance sheet allowed flexibility in pursuing opportunities.

episode.title: CEO Series: Larry Diamond - Retail Investor Earnings Call (first ever!) | Zip Co (ASX: Z1P)

views.text: In April 2021, a guest on Equity Mates said a $400 million raise provided runway to become a serious US player, scale the UK and seed other markets, while broadening the Australian product ecosystem.

episode.title: CEO Series: Larry Diamond of Zip (ASX: Z1P)

views.text: In December 2020, Equity Mates explained Zip’s expansion had been heavily acquisition-led, naming deals like QuadPay and PartPay to supercharge entry into new markets rather than build organically.

steps.q: Can it be bought at a reasonable price?

views.text: In October 2026, a guest on Equity Mates said Zip traded on a teen multiple, about 14 to 15 times earnings, while growing over 30%, and contrasted that with recent short-seller pressure.

episode.title: 3 of Australia’s most shorted stocks (and 2 BIG buys)
